summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor (buffers the control and returns True when is_terminal, else False); rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not verified: tests and Black formatting were not run, per instructions.
